name: Audit My Cache
description: Scored audit of a website's HTTP cache policy — a score out of 100, a grade (A to E) and six KPIs with their status (repeat-visit reuse, validators and 304, versioned names, lifetimes, compression, safety). Covers — HTML pages, scripts, styles, images, fonts, API answers, redirects — as an anonymous visitor gets it and as a signed-in visitor should: versioned file names or not, how long each file is kept, ETag and Last-Modified validators and 304 answers, compression, cookies on shareable answers. Measures what a second visit downloads again, finds in the code or the server configuration (Caddy, nginx, Apache, Express, Next.js, Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare) where each rule comes from, then proposes a target policy for anonymous and signed-in visitors with fixes ready to apply. Needs Node 18+.
